project_scope: QuranHikma Tafsir only; separate from Global Equb

target.question: Do the cited Tirmidhi witness identifiers and the printed chain remain distinct from Qurtubi's own report wording, and do the live paired rows preserve the same report fragment?

actions.action: Compared the live Qurtubi Arabic and English row fragments with KSU's Qurtubi electronic witness and the named Jami at-Tirmidhi report as represented by Sunnah.com and Islamtics.
actions.result: Live Arabic says Qurtubi also reports al-Tirmidhi from Ibn Umar and carries the report matn; the stored English likewise identifies al-Tirmidhi/Ibn Umar and carries the translated matn. Live row hashes are unchanged.

actions.action: Cross-checked source-site identifiers for the same Arabic report text.
actions.result: Sunnah.com labels it Jami at-Tirmidhi 3361 and Book 47, Hadith 413 (also showing the legacy English translation label Vol. 5, Book 44, Hadith 3361). Islamtics labels its record 3361 and Book 47, Hadith 413, but its notes say Arabic Book 47, Hadith 3686. Preserve the platform-specific numbering as a crosswalk discrepancy; do not treat the identifiers alone as distinct report variants.

actions.action: Compared attribution wording and printed chain.
actions.result: Qurtubi attributes the citation to al-Tirmidhi and names Ibn Umar as the report source, but does not print a full isnad here. Sunnah.com prints Hannad -> Muhammad ibn Fudayl -> Ata ibn al-Sa'ib -> Muharib ibn Dithar -> Abdullah ibn Umar -> the Prophet. This is a chain attested in that cited collection witness only; no route is added to Qurtubi data and no authenticity judgment is made.

source_anchors.supports: Qurtubi writes that al-Tirmidhi also reports from Ibn Umar and quotes the al-Kawthar river report; the page label is an electronic locator, not a print-page claim.
The named report's Arabic chain and matn, plus Sunnah.com's reference crosswalk.

source_anchors.locator: Arabic text lines 93-100; reference notes lines 110-122
source_anchors.supports: Same displayed chain and matn; page notes its Arabic numbering as Book 47, Hadith 3686 while the record heading is 3361 and in-book reference is 413.

source_anchors.supports: Current paired row hashes and the exact source-provenance boundary are recorded below; source_url remains a legacy numeric identifier.

arabic_row.excerpt: وروَى الترمذي أيضا عن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول الله ... الكوثر: نهر في الجنة، حافتاه من ذهب، ومجراه على الدر والياقوت، تربته أطيب من المسك، وماؤه أحلى من العسل وأبيض من الثلج. هذا حديث حسن صحيح.

english_row.excerpt: Al-Tirmidhi also reported from Ibn Umar, who said the Messenger of God ... Al-Kawthar is a river in Paradise. Its banks are of gold, its bed flows with pearls and rubies, its soil is purer than musk, and its water is sweeter than honey and whiter than snow.

finding.result: The paired live witnesses preserve the Qurtubi source cue and report fragment. The Tirmidhi chain is explicitly visible in the cited collection witness; Qurtubi's text here names Tirmidhi and Ibn Umar without reproducing that full chain. Identifier 3361, in-book 413, old English volume/book label, and Islamtics Arabic 3686 must stay typed and source-specific.
finding.scope_guard: Do not infer independent route corroboration, hadith authenticity, or the provenance of the stored English translation from matching wording. Do not convert source_url='671' into a URL or page locator.

next_bounded_step: Keep the Tirmidhi source-number crosswalk and Qurtubi report voice separate in review; continue a different held Qurtubi claim only after this staged comparison is independently checked. No SQL application, live write, merge, publication, UI validation, or Sūrah 107 transition.
